paper_title: Unifying Monopole and Center Vortex as the Semiclassical Confinement Mechanism (Hayashi, 2024, Physical Review Letters)
deeper_reasoning_1:
\textbf{Claim.}
The equality between the reduced shift-twisted monopole gas and the constrained two-dimensional vortex gas is not merely equality after two independent sums have been evaluated.  It is a term-by-term equality of the $N$ branch weights, and within the displayed reduced formulae it forces the fugacity relation
\[
\zeta_v=NL_3\zeta_m .
\]

\textbf{Premises.}
\[
\begin{array}{ll}
\text{(P1)} & N\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge2},\quad V>0,\quad L_3>0,
\quad \zeta_m>0,
\quad \zeta_v>0,
\quad \theta\in\mathbb{R}.\\[1mm]
\text{(P2)} & \mathbb{Z}_N=\{0,1,\ldots,N-1\}.\\[1mm]
\text{(P3)} & \displaystyle B^{(v)}_k(\theta):=
\exp\left(2V\zeta_v\cos\frac{\theta+2\pi k}{N}\right),
\qquad k\in\mathbb{Z}_N.\\[3mm]
\text{(P4)} & \displaystyle B^{(m)}_k(\theta):=
\exp\left(2NVL_3\zeta_m\cos\frac{\theta+2\pi k}{N}\right),
\qquad k\in\mathbb{Z}_N.\\[3mm]
\text{(P5)} & \displaystyle Z_{2D}^{\mathrm{vtx}}(\theta)=\sum_{k\in\mathbb{Z}_N}B^{(v)}_k(\theta),
\qquad
Z_{3D}^{\mathrm{tw},0}(\theta)=\sum_{k\in\mathbb{Z}_N}B^{(m)}_k(\theta).\\[3mm]
\text{(P6)} & \displaystyle \cos\left(a+2\pi r\right)=\cos a
\quad\text{for all }a\in\mathbb{R},\ r\in\mathbb{Z}.\\[2mm]
\text{(P7)} & \displaystyle e^x=e^y\text{ for real }x,y\text{ implies }x=y.
\end{array}
\]

\textbf{Derivation.}
First check the required $2\pi$ covariance.  For every $k\in\mathbb{Z}_N$,
\begin{align}
B^{(v)}_k(\theta+2\pi)
&=\exp\left(2V\zeta_v\cos\frac{\theta+2\pi+2\pi k}{N}\right)\\
&=\exp\left(2V\zeta_v\cos\frac{\theta+2\pi(k+1)}{N}\right)\\
&=B^{(v)}_{k+1}(\theta),
\end{align}
with the label $k+1$ understood modulo $N$.  The same computation gives
\begin{align}
B^{(m)}_k(\theta+2\pi)=B^{(m)}_{k+1}(\theta).
\end{align}
Thus both descriptions have the same branch permutation under $\theta\mapsto\theta+2\pi$; a comparison of the two theories must therefore compare equal branch labels, up to one global cyclic relabelling.

Assume that the two reduced branch weights agree for all $\theta$ and all branch labels after such a relabelling.  Since a cyclic relabelling can be absorbed by replacing $k$ with $k+k_0$, it is enough to impose
\begin{align}
B^{(v)}_k(\theta)&=B^{(m)}_k(\theta)
\qquad\text{for all }\theta\in\mathbb{R},\ k\in\mathbb{Z}_N .
\end{align}
Using (P3), (P4), and (P7), this is equivalent to
\begin{align}
2V\zeta_v\cos\frac{\theta+2\pi k}{N}
&=2NVL_3\zeta_m\cos\frac{\theta+2\pi k}{N}
\qquad\text{for all }\theta,k .
\end{align}
Set $\theta=-2\pi k$.  Then the cosine equals $1$, so
\begin{align}
2V\zeta_v&=2NVL_3\zeta_m,\\
\zeta_v&=NL_3\zeta_m,
\end{align}
because $V>0$.  This proves necessity within the displayed branch-weight formulae.

Conversely, if $\zeta_v=NL_3\zeta_m$, then for every $k$ and $\theta$,
\begin{align}
B^{(v)}_k(\theta)
&=\exp\left(2V(NL_3\zeta_m)\cos\frac{\theta+2\pi k}{N}\right)\\
&=\exp\left(2NVL_3\zeta_m\cos\frac{\theta+2\pi k}{N}\right)\\
&=B^{(m)}_k(\theta).
\end{align}
Summing over $k\in\mathbb{Z}_N$ gives
\begin{align}
Z_{2D}^{\mathrm{vtx}}(\theta)
&=\sum_{k\in\mathbb{Z}_N}B^{(v)}_k(\theta)\\
&=\sum_{k\in\mathbb{Z}_N}B^{(m)}_k(\theta)\\
&=Z_{3D}^{\mathrm{tw},0}(\theta).
\end{align}

\textbf{Final Result.}
\[
\boxed{Z_{2D}^{\mathrm{vtx}}(\theta)=Z_{3D}^{\mathrm{tw},0}(\theta)
\text{ term by term in }k
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
\zeta_v=NL_3\zeta_m}
\]
within the displayed reduced branch formulae.  The shared branch permutation
\[
\boxed{B_k(\theta+2\pi)=B_{k+1}(\theta)}
\]
shows that the matching also preserves the expected $N$-branch structure.
\hfill$\blacksquare$

deeper_metadata.revision_intent: Improve alignment by replacing the weakest localization entry with a direct zero-mode-free period-NL3 Fourier argument, extending Wilson-loop reasoning to oriented N-ality, and adding a joint selection-rule bridge between the vortex-gas projector and the microscopic Wilson-loop test.

rubric_interpretation.schema: Use exactly paper_title, contiguous deeper_reasoning_k string fields, and one deeper_metadata object; keep all audit material inside deeper_metadata.
rubric_interpretation.latex: Each deeper_reasoning_k is a standalone LaTeX fragment using only constructs compatible with article, amsmath, and amssymb.
rubric_interpretation.value_standard: A high-value entry must add necessity, robustness, hidden equivalence, or cross-goal integration rather than merely repeating a core derivation.

goal_trace.joint_conjunction: The entries jointly cover branch-level partition-function equality, exponential localization, piecewise vortex flux, Wilson-loop center response, and the shared Z_N selection rule linking the gas projector to the microscopic vortex test.

deeper_reasoning_1.title: Term-by-term branch equivalence and necessity of the fugacity map
deeper_reasoning_1.goal_alignment: Directly proves the after-and-only-after fugacity identification required by G1 within the displayed reduced formulae.
deeper_reasoning_1.scientific_payoff: Upgrades the partition-function match from resemblance of sums to exact equality of physical branches.
deeper_reasoning_1.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Adds the iff structure and branch-permutation check not isolated in the core derivations.
deeper_reasoning_1.formal_sharpness: Restricts necessity to the reduced branch weights and derives it from a unit-cosine branch evaluation.
deeper_reasoning_1.low_value_rejection_audit: Avoids redoing the vortex occupation sum or the monopole saddle substitution already present in core_reasoning.
deeper_reasoning_1.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The proof does not claim equality of the unreduced full path integrals; metadata and claim text restrict it to displayed reduced formulae.

deeper_reasoning_2.title: Zero-mode-free period-NL3 Fourier proof of vortex localization
deeper_reasoning_2.goal_alignment: Supplies the exponential localization criterion and the transverse scale NL3/(2*pi) required by G2.
deeper_reasoning_2.scientific_payoff: Shows why the shifted monopole is vortex-like rather than Coulombic at large transverse distance.
deeper_reasoning_2.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Connects the twist gap and the image-chain neutrality into a direct large-distance decay argument.
deeper_reasoning_2.formal_sharpness: States the period, zero-mode coefficient, minimum nonzero momentum, and tail estimate explicitly.
deeper_reasoning_2.low_value_rejection_audit: Replaces a bare quotation of the target asymptotic with a concrete Fourier-mode mechanism.
controlled_external_lemmas: Standard two-dimensional nonzero Fourier Green mode decays as O(exp(-|p|r)).
deeper_reasoning_2.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The only external analytic input is explicitly declared; the rate 2*pi/(N L3) itself is derived from the period and zero-mode cancellation.

deeper_reasoning_3.title: Flux jump as the monopole-to-vortex kink condition
deeper_reasoning_3.goal_alignment: Turns the piecewise flux formula required by G2 into the exact charge-jump relation for a monopole kink.
deeper_reasoning_3.scientific_payoff: Identifies the monopole as the local transition between adjacent fundamental center-vortex flux sectors.
deeper_reasoning_3.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Adds the jump calculation, sign interpretation, and boundary-twist consistency check.
deeper_reasoning_3.formal_sharpness: Computes the right-left flux discontinuity and distinguishes the physical kink from the twisted boundary relabelling.
deeper_reasoning_3.low_value_rejection_audit: Avoids duplicating the full plane-integral calculation from core_reasoning_4.
deeper_reasoning_3.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The argument assumes the core piecewise flux formula; its contribution is interpretation and consistency, not rederivation of the plane integral.

deeper_reasoning_4.title: Oriented Wilson-loop N-ality response
deeper_reasoning_4.goal_alignment: Contains the required one-vortex phase and no-vortex phase as special cases while also covering antivortex orientation.
deeper_reasoning_4.scientific_payoff: Shows that the Wilson loop detects center charge only, not microscopic flux labels.
deeper_reasoning_4.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Extends the single-flux Wilson-loop result to arbitrary oriented collections and derives dependence only on signed N-ality.
deeper_reasoning_4.formal_sharpness: Uses signed integer counts to remove dependence on individual labels a_j.
deeper_reasoning_4.low_value_rejection_audit: Avoids merely restating W=e^{-2*pi*i/N}; it proves the full oriented selection law.
deeper_reasoning_4.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The entry remains inside fundamental Wilson-loop responses and does not claim higher-representation characters.
